jsonld.description: Custom cake and dessert artist in Orlando, FL: birthday cakes, wedding cakes, baby showers and more.

script.es: Cada pastel, hecho a tu medida.
script.en: Every cake, made just for you.

parrafo.es: Auri Sweets crea pasteles personalizados en Orlando para cumpleanos, bodas, baby showers y bautizos, con 5.0 estrellas en Google y 286 resenas que destacan el sabor y el detalle en cada diseno.
parrafo.en: Auri Sweets creates custom cakes in Orlando for birthdays, weddings, baby showers and baptisms, holding a 5.0 rating on Google across 286 reviews that praise both the flavor and the detail in every design.

hero.imagen_alt: Pastel de boda floral de tres pisos hecho por Auri Sweets

parrafo_1.es: Auri Sweets diseña pasteles personalizados en Orlando: desde cumpleanos tematicos hasta pasteles de boda, baby showers y bautizos, replicando el diseno exacto que cada cliente imagina.
parrafo_1.en: Auri Sweets designs custom cakes in Orlando: from themed birthday cakes to wedding cakes, baby showers and baptisms, matching the exact design each client has in mind.

parrafo_2.es: Las 286 resenas en Google repiten lo mismo: comunicacion clara desde el primer mensaje, disenos que replican fielmente la referencia enviada, y un sabor que no decepciona.
parrafo_2.en: The 286 reviews on Google say the same thing again and again: clear communication from the first message, designs that faithfully match the reference photo sent, and flavor that never disappoints.

texto.es: Llama o escribe con la ocasion, la fecha y una foto de referencia si ya tienes una en mente.
texto.en: Call or message with the occasion, the date and a reference photo if you already have one in mind.

texto.es: Te confirmamos sabor, tamano y diseno, con una cotizacion clara antes de empezar.
texto.en: We confirm flavor, size and design, with a clear quote before we start.

texto.es: Cada pastel se hornea y decora a mano para tu fecha, nunca con anticipacion de mas.
texto.en: Every cake is baked and decorated by hand for your date, never too far in advance.

texto.es: Recibes tu pastel listo para la celebracion, igual al diseno que acordamos.
texto.en: You receive your cake ready for the celebration, matching the design we agreed on.

nota.es: Cada pastel se cotiza segun diseno, tamano y porciones. Llama o escribe para tu cotizacion.
nota.en: Every cake is quoted based on design, size and servings. Call or message for your quote.

texto.es: Desde pasteles tematicos de personajes hasta disenos elegantes, replicando la foto que nos envies.
texto.en: From themed character cakes to elegant designs, matching the photo you send us.

texto.es: Pasteles de varios pisos con flores naturales o de azucar, a la medida de tu celebracion.
texto.en: Multi-tier cakes with fresh or sugar flowers, built to match your celebration.

texto.es: Disenos delicados para esos momentos especiales en familia.
texto.en: Delicate designs for those special family moments.

texto.es: Mesas de postres completas con cupcakes, tartas y mas, a juego con el pastel principal.
texto.en: Full dessert tables with cupcakes, tarts and more, matched to the main cake.

pie.es: No ves el diseno que buscas? Escribenos con tu referencia, trabajamos disenos personalizados cada semana.
pie.en: Don't see the design you want? Send us your reference, we work on custom designs every week.

items.quote: From my very first interaction with Auri, she was pleasant, responsive, and incredibly professional.
Aura made my baby shower cake. She replicated the photo I sent her. She even offered us cake samples.
The cake was absolutely delicious! It was so moist, filled with rich chocolate.
